A base of sandalwood and salted caramel accords adds a smooth, creamy depth that feels indulgent without being heavy, settling into a long-lasting trail that stays close to the skin throughout the day.
 Light enough for daily use, this body mist offers an easy way to layer scent or refresh throughout the day. A go-to for anyone drawn to warm, sweet and tropical-inspired fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 68 240ml Perfume Mist
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=YHGUTRT]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 68 Perfume Mist is a sparkling floral fragrance that captures the feeling of a sun-soaked tropical escape. Light, vibrant and effortlessly wearable, it carries the warmth and energy of a distant shoreline from the first spray to the last lingering note.
 The fragrance opens with bright top notes of pink dragonfruit and lychee that feel fresh and juicy on the skin. A heart of Brazilian jasmine, ocean air and hibiscus adds an airy, uplifting quality that brings to mind open skies and warm coastal breezes. Creamy vanilla and sun musk settle into the base, adding a soft sensual warmth that rounds out the scent beautifully.
 Fresh, floral and fun, this body mist is a go-to for those who love a lively, sun-inspired fragrance that wears easily throughout the day.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love 100ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=RJDUEEV]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love Eau de Parfum is a layered floral built on zesty citrus, soft blooms and a warm, musky base. Bright, alluring and effortlessly wearable.
 Mandarin and orange flower petals lead the opening with a fresh, sparkling energy before giving way to a floral heart of hibiscus and freesia that adds femininity and depth. As the scent settles, vanilla and rich musks draw the composition into a smooth, seductive dry down that sits close to the skin.
 Equally comfortable worn during the day as it is on an evening out, this Eau de Parfum carries enough presence to feel special without ever being overpowering.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Forever 50ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=LRGFUAX]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Narciso Rodriguez For Her Forever Eau de Parfum is a modern take on the house's celebrated musc signature, blending white florals with warm, earthy depth. Radiant, feminine and quietly commanding.
 Frangipani buds and gardenia open the scent with a soft, creamy brightness before jasmine, tuberose and osmanthus flower take over at the heart, creating a full, textured floral bouquet. The base draws on Narciso Rodriguez's iconic heart of muscs, paired with patchouli to add an earthy richness that gives the fragrance a lasting, skin-hugging warmth.
 A refined everyday fragrance with enough depth to carry into the evening, For Her Forever works well year-round. The ombré glass bottle, shifting from black to soft pink, reflects the contrast of strength and softness at the core of the scent.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden White Tea 100ml Eau de Toilette
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=VQXVXGQ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Elizabeth Arden White Tea is a calming woody floral musk inspired by the simple pleasure of a warm cup of tea at the end of a long day. Soft, serene and comforting.
 Mandarin orange and clary sage lead the opening alongside fresh fern and light sea notes, creating a crisp, airy start. The heart brings white tea, mate and white iris together in a smooth, clean floral blend. As it dries down, amber, ambrette, tonka bean and exotic woods add a gentle, grounding warmth that stays close to the skin.
 An easy, understated fragrance that works from morning through to evening, White Tea is a reliable everyday choice that never feels overdone. Its quiet, soothing character also makes it a thoughtful option as a gift.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain La Petite Robe Noire 100ml Eau de Toilette
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=YT5EHT1]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Guerlain La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Toilette is a delicate floral fragrance built around the Centifolia rose from Grasse, crafted with 90% naturally derived ingredients. Fresh, tender and effortlessly feminine.
 The scent centres on a sparkling rose note, lifted by tangy fruity accords that give it a playful, bright character. White amber and white musk sit beneath, adding a layer of softness and warmth that rounds out the dry down into a clean, comfortable trail. It feels light and airy without losing depth.
 A versatile daytime fragrance with a gentle presence, La Petite Robe Noire works well for everyday wear across seasons. Housed in Guerlain's signature "inverted heart" bottle dressed in soft pink, it also makes a thoughtful gift, with the option to add a free custom engraving for a personal touch.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Elixir de Parfum 100ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=P6F0OJ2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Burberry Her Elixir de Parfum is an intense, fruit-drenched gourmand built on dark berries, heady jasmine and a warm, lingering base. Confident, sensual and enveloping.
 Juicy strawberry and blackberry lead the opening with a sweet, inviting richness before giving way to a jasmine heart that adds depth and a floral sophistication. The dry down is where the fragrance really settles in, with vanilla, amber and sandalwood blending into a smooth, skin-hugging warmth that lasts for hours.
 A step up in intensity from the rest of the Burberry Her range, this Elixir de Parfum is well suited to cooler evenings and nights out. The opaque pink bottle, echoing the heritage Burberry design from 1981, adds a luxurious finishing touch.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Forever & Ever 50ml Eau de Toilette
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=XA6EYUS]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Dior Forever and Ever is a soft, romantic floral built on jasmine petals, Bulgarian rose and fresh freesia. Tender, feminine and beautifully understated.
 The fragrance centres on a delicate balance of jasmine and Bulgarian rose, offering a classic floral warmth that feels refined and timeless. Freesia brings a crisp, lighter note that opens the composition up, preventing it from feeling too rich and giving it an effortless, wearable quality. It dries down to a gentle, skin-close trail.
 Light enough for everyday wear and perfectly suited to spring and summer, Forever and Ever is an elegant option for those who prefer their florals clean and uncomplicated.

listings.rawTitle: Shiseido Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing 15ml Eye Cream
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=COOK2L9]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Shiseido Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream is a high-performance eye treatment that targets six types of wrinkles around the eye area, with visible improvements in just five days. Smoothing, firming and deeply hydrating.
 The formula is built around ReneuraRED Technology, which helps activate the skin's own repair response, supported by carnosine to protect against oxidative damage. The algae-based KOMBU-Bounce complex and botanical extracts work to plump and moisturise, while Aqua Peptide softens the skin for a noticeably smoother, refreshed look.
 Designed for twice-daily use as the finishing step to a skincare routine, the cream works well under makeup and delivers consistent, long-lasting results with continued use.

listings.rawTitle: Shiseido Bio-Performance Advanced Super Revitalising 50ml Cream
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=F1FQJE0]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Shiseido Advanced Super Revitalizer Cream is a firming, anti-ageing moisturiser that targets fine lines, wrinkles and loss of elasticity. Hydrating, smoothing and restorative.
 Powered by TruStructiv technology alongside a Bio-Renewal Complex, the formula works to strengthen and replenish the skin, helping to restore firmness and improve overall texture. With regular use, the complexion looks visibly smoother, more hydrated and revitalised.
 Apply morning and evening to cleansed skin with fingertips as the last step in your routine. The cream absorbs well and layers comfortably under makeup or sunscreen for seamless daytime wear.

listings.rawTitle: Shiseido Bio-Performance Advanced Super Revitalising Cream 75ml
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=G8HLXIQ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Shiseido Advanced Super Revitalizer Cream is a rich, restorative moisturiser designed to reduce the visible signs of ageing while keeping the skin deeply hydrated. Firming, smoothing and revitalising.
 The formula pairs TruStructiv technology with a Bio-Renewal Complex to work on multiple fronts, helping to firm, moisturise and renew the skin's appearance over time. Fine lines and wrinkles look visibly softened, while the skin feels stronger and more supple.
 Best used twice daily on cleansed skin as the closing step of a skincare routine. It blends easily with fingertips and feels comfortable throughout the day or overnight.

listings.rawTitle: Shiseido Ultimune Power Infusing 75ml Serum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=GUU59L4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Shiseido Ultimune Power Infusing Concentrate is a high-performance serum built to slow visible signs of ageing and strengthen the skin's natural resilience. Powerful, concentrated and clinically proven.
 At the core of the formula is a patented Power Fermented Camellia extract, developed through a Japanese bio fermentation process and combined with four additional Camellia extracts. This supports the skin's moisture barrier and helps address loss of firmness, elasticity and radiance. In consumer testing, 98% of users reported improved signs of ageing after one month of use.
 Lightweight and quick to absorb, the concentrate works well as a treatment step before moisturiser in both morning and evening routines. A consistent, results-driven addition to any skincare regimen.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne 4 x 5ml Eau de Parfum Gift Set
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=B016NAN]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}The Miniatures For Her Gift Set contains 4 of Paco Rabanne's best-selling and most popular fragrances for women. Whether you're looking to find a new signature fragrance, or want travel-sized perfumes to help you feel more confident on the road, this set has you covered.Set Includes:
 
 5ml Lady Million EDP
 6ml Olympea EDP
 4ml Fame EDP
 4ml Fame Parfum EDP

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Intense 50ml Eau de Parfum Gift Set
listings.description:
Narciso Rodriguez For Her Intense Eau de Parfum is the bold new evolution of one of the world's most beloved fragrance signatures — deeper, richer and undeniably addictive. 
 
 Opening with a vibrant burst of juicy peach and Calabrian bergamot, the scent unfolds into a hypnotic heart of white flowers, red spider lily and the house's iconic musc accord. Warm base notes of vetiver, moss, amber and vanilla create a lingering, sensual trail that feels like a second skin.
 
 Presented in iconic Narciso Rodriguez packaging, this gift set is the perfect treat for yourself or someone special. A sophisticated, long-lasting scent for the confident, sensual woman.
 Top Notes: Peach, Calabrian Bergamot · Heart Notes: White Flowers, Red Spider Lily, Musc · Base Notes: Vetiver, Moss, Amber, Vanilla

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone English Oak & Hazelnut 100ml Eau de Cologne
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=EUHGKS1]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Warm woods, soft spice, and a smooth nutty finish make this cologne feel calm and confident. Jo Malone English Oak & Hazelnut opens with fresh green notes before settling into rich oak and roasted hazelnut, creating a scent that feels earthy without being heavy. It’s clean, modern, and easy to wear from day to night. Perfect for anyone who likes understated fragrances with a cozy, refined edge.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Voce Viva Intense 30ml Eau De Parfum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=U6MEEO2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Valentino Voce Viva is a striking chypre floral that balances opulent white flowers with a rich, mossy vanilla base. Luminous, warm and unapologetically sensual.
 The opening sparkles with bergamot and mandarin accords, giving way to a full-bodied floral heart of orange blossom and jasmine absolute that feels both elegant and modern. Crystal moss anchors the base with an earthy depth, made irresistibly smooth by a double dose of bourbon vanilla that adds a creamy, lasting warmth to the dry down.
 Voce Viva works well from late afternoon into the evening and comes into its own during autumn and winter. A confident choice for those drawn to florals with real substance and staying power.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy 50ml Eau de Toilette Gift Set
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=KXJGCXC]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Eau de Toilette is a sharp, spice-driven fragrance that pairs raw energy with a smooth, gourmand base. Bold, layered and full of character.
 Black and white pepper hit first with an immediate kick, brightened by bergamot before the scent moves into a woody, aromatic heart of cedarwood and sage. As it dries down, tonka bean and cocoa take over, adding a rich, almost addictive sweetness that balances out the spice and gives the fragrance real staying power.
 This gift set comes with a 50ml Eau de Toilette Spray, a handy 10ml travel spray for on the go, and a 100ml shower gel to build the scent from the ground up. Housed in the distinctive lightning bolt bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Jeans 125ml Eau de Toilette
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=VV44CWI]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Hugo Boss HUGO Jeans Eau de Toilette is a bright, energetic cologne that balances citrus and herbal freshness with a warm, woody dry down. Crisp, confident and laid-back.
 Grapefruit, peppermint and juniper berries open with an invigorating freshness that grabs attention without being overpowering. The heart transitions smoothly into sandalwood and vetiver, grounding the scent with a masculine warmth and giving it a long-wearing, comfortable trail that stays close to the skin.
 Versatile enough to carry through every season, HUGO Jeans is a straightforward, easy-reach fragrance for everyday wear. Presented in a distinctive matte denim flask with the iconic red and black HUGO logo.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry London 50ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=YXP4TCC]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Burberry London for Women Eau de Parfum is a polished floral with a warm, subtle base, inspired by the style and spirit of the city. Bright, elegant and endlessly wearable.
 Honeysuckle, tangerine and rose lead the opening with a fresh, light sweetness before jasmine, tiare flower, peony and clementine zest build a rich, feminine heart. The dry down softens into sandalwood, musk and patchouli, adding a gentle warmth that rounds out the composition and gives it a lasting, skin-close presence.
 A reliable choice across seasons that works as easily in the office as it does on an evening out. The 50ml bottle, wrapped in Burberry's iconic check fabric, blends fragrance and fashion in one piece.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Angel 15ml Eau de Parfum Refillable
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=TCE368F]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Mugler Angel Eau de Parfum is the fragrance that introduced the gourmand family to perfumery, built on a striking contrast of sweet indulgence and dark, woody depth. Daring, powerful and entirely its own.
 Bergamot opens with a clean, citrus lift that quickly gives way to a decadent praline heart, rich and enveloping. Patchouli and vanilla absolute form the base, adding an earthy warmth and creamy sweetness that intertwine into a distinctive, long-wearing trail unlike anything else on the skin.
 A statement scent that carries equal weight day or night, Angel is for those who want something that stands apart. The signature blue star bottle marks 30 years of one of the most recognisable fragrances in the world.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Irresistible Nude Velvet 80ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=RL98H5Q]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Parfum Nude Velvet is a smooth, skin-hugging floral that enhances the line's signature rose-wood character with a creamy, musky depth. Soft, tactile and effortlessly feminine.
 Almond oil, ambrette absolute and Tunisian neroli open with a gentle, enveloping warmth that draws you in. The heart blooms with Turkish rose water, rose essential and French iris concrete, layering rich florals with a powdery refinement. Cedarwood essence, musks and a rice powder accord complete the dry down, adding a woody softness that lingers close to the skin without heaviness.
 A polished, understated fragrance that works seamlessly from day into evening. Housed in the collection's nude pink lacquered flacon, it carries a quiet luxury that suits everyday wear.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Defy 50ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=CLKKQS7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Calvin Klein Defy Eau de Parfum is a rich, leather-driven woody fragrance with a fresh citrus opening and a deep, long-lasting base. Intense, confident and modern.
 Mandarin oil and black pepper cut through with an immediate freshness before a smooth leather accord takes over at the heart, layered with saffiano and suede for a darker, more rugged edge than the original. The base draws on vetiver oil, responsibly sourced from Haiti, adding a natural earthiness and a masculine warmth that anchors the scent for hours.
 A versatile fragrance with strong projection and longevity, Defy EDP works well year-round and transitions comfortably from the office to an evening out. Presented in the signature minimalist bottle, drawing on denim and Calvin Klein's iconic design codes.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Fame Body Lotion 200ml
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=HSKCJRG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Rabanne Fame Body Lotion is a deeply moisturising formula scented with the fresh, creamy character of the Fame fragrance. Hydrating, softening and beautifully fragrant.
 Infused with jasmine, mango and incense, the 200ml lotion leaves the skin feeling smooth and lightly perfumed throughout the day. An easy way to extend the wearing experience of the Fame line, whether used alone or layered underneath the Eau de Parfum for a richer, longer-lasting trail.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Sheer Beauty 50ml Eau de Toilette
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=INX5EUQ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Calvin Klein Sheer Beauty Eau de Toilette is a bright, breezy fruity floral that pairs fresh fruit and soft blooms with a clean, musky base. Radiant, delicate and naturally feminine.
 Bergamot, red berries and peach Bellini create a lively, juicy opening that quickly settles into a graceful floral heart of peony, lily and jasmine. As the scent develops, musk, vanilla and sandalwood bring a smooth, understated warmth to the dry down, giving the fragrance a soft trail that lasts throughout the day.
 A natural choice for everyday wear during the warmer months, Sheer Beauty carries a relaxed, uncomplicated charm that never feels overdone.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Alien 15ml Eau de Parfum Refillable
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=O1YPB6H]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Mugler Alien Eau de Parfum is an intense, solar fragrance that wraps rich jasmine in deep woody and amber warmth. Enveloping, luminous and unmistakably bold.
 Jasmine sits at the core, full and unrestrained, giving the scent its signature radiance and floral strength. Warm woody notes and amber embrace the heart, adding a mysterious depth and a smooth, lasting dry down that holds close to the skin. It projects with confidence without losing its warmth.
 A long-wearing fragrance with strong character, Alien suits those who want something with presence and staying power. The bottle is designed to be refilled, either at home with the Mugler refill bottles or in store at the Mugler Fountain.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 62 90ml Perfume Mist
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=VDPPWV8]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 62 Body Mist brings the brand's beloved Bum Bum Cream scent to life in a light, wearable spray that transports the senses to a warm summer's day on the coast of Rio. Vibrant, playful and effortlessly uplifting, it captures a holiday feeling that lingers from morning to evening.
 The fragrance opens with warming notes of pistachio and almond layered with a soft bloom of jasmine petals. A base of sandalwood and salted caramel accords adds a smooth, creamy depth that feels indulgent without being heavy, settling into a long-lasting trail that stays close to the skin throughout the day.
 Light enough for daily use, this body mist offers an easy way to layer scent or refresh throughout the day. A go-to for anyone drawn to warm, sweet and tropical-inspired fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss The Scent 200ml Refill Eau de Toilette
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=MXX9RKG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}There's a certain kind of confidence that doesn't announce itself. It just enters the room. BOSS The Scent for Him is built around that feeling.
 This Eau de Toilette isn't trying to be subtle. It opens with a sharp hit of natural Ginger oil, warm, a little fierce, the kind of opener that sets a tone without apology. Then comes Maninka fruit, a rare ingredient developed exclusively for BOSS, softening the edges just enough to pull you in rather than push you away. That push-pull tension is what makes the whole thing work.
 The dry-down settles into Leather. Not the cold, stiff kind, but something warmer and lived-in. It lingers in a way that's hard to ignore and harder to forget.
 The bottle suits the juice. Translucent glass with the BOSS logo, a gunmetal Double-B cap, and a shape that catches light from every angle. It looks good on a shelf and even better when someone notices it on you.
 Refillable too, because something this good shouldn't be disposable.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone Nectarine Blossom & Honey 100ml Eau de Cologne
listings.description: Jo Malone Nectarine Blossom & Honey sits comfortably in the elegant category without trying too hard. This eau de cologne from Jo keeps things floral and approachable.You'll catch Bergamot, Citrus straight away before Jasmine, Rose emerge in the heart. It finishes with Vanilla, Musk, which is where the fragrance really finds its character and sticks around.This eau de cologne suits different occasions pretty well. Fragrance Notes:Top Notes: Bergamot, Citrus, Fresh floralsMiddle Notes: Jasmine, Rose, Floral bouquetBase Notes: Vanilla, Musk, Woody notes

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild 50ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=JT4TWBI]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild is a floral Eau de Parfum that brings the essence of wild gardens to skin. The scent is fresh and sensual, with a playful spirit that feels natural and alive.
 Opening with fruity banana blossom, the fragrance creates an immediate sense of brightness. Jasmine emerges in the heart, introducing a delicate florality that softens the composition. The base of sandalwood, vetiver and macadamia adds warmth and sophistication, creating a scent that unfolds gracefully from first spray to final wear.
 The 50ml bottle arrives in soft pastel green with colourful flowers adorning the cap and descending into the flacon—a whimsical design that captures the fragrance's character.

listings.rawTitle: Chloe Chloe Intense 100ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=IC3XI2B]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Chloé L'Eau de Parfum Intense for Women is a floral fragrance rooted in the spirit of the modern Chloé woman. Confident, optimistic and free, this 100ml Eau de Parfum Intense layers florals with warm depth.
 Opening with juicy raspberry, the fragrance immediately feels lively and bright. Rose emerges as the dominant note, shifting through different expressions as the scent unfolds. Fresh in the opening, rich at midday, honeyed in the evening. This multi-faceted rose sits on a base of ambery woods, smooth cashmeran and warm cedar, creating a sensual finish.
 The pleated Chloé bottle is refined with a sleek black and ecru label and deep garnet ribbon. This composition adapts throughout the day, revealing different qualities with wear.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense 100ml Eau de Parfum Gift Set
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=TM7CSHG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense Eau de Parfum is a deeper, more intense take on the Flora Gorgeous Gardenia fragrance, built around a gardenia-forward floral heart with a warm woody base.
 The fragrance opens on Italian Mandarin Essence, delivering a fresh, luminous citrus lift before the heart takes hold. Gardenia Accord and Hedione form a lush, clean floral centre with a soft transparency that keeps the composition from feeling heavy. Sandalwood Essence rounds out the base, adding a smooth warmth that carries the florals into a gentle, lingering dry down.
 Presented in the house's signature fuchsia Flora-patterned packaging, this gift set includes a 100ml eau de parfum, a 10ml pen spray and a 5ml miniature.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild 30ml + 10ml Eau de Parfum Gift Set
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=F4W8PK9]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau de Parfum takes the Daisy line into wilder, more nature-rooted territory with a floral composition built around jasmine, banana blossom and macadamia.
 The fragrance opens with the light, fruity softness of banana blossom before a jasmine-led heart brings a sensuous, full-bodied floral quality to the centre. Macadamia adds a warm nuttiness that sits comfortably alongside the base of sandalwood and vetiver des sables, which together give the dry down a grounded, woody depth that balances the brightness of the opening.
 Presented as a gift set with a 30ml eau de parfum and a 10ml travel atomiser, the pastel green bottle features multicoloured flowers on its cap and is compatible with the 150ml Daisy Wild refill.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her 100ml + 10ml Eau de Parfum Set
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=A7J2YFB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Narciso Rodriguez For Her Pure Musc Eau de Parfum Gift Set brings together two complementary fragrances from the For Her line, built around the house's signature musc and designed to be layered or worn separately.
 For Her Pure Musc opens on a floral accord of orange blossom and jasmine before the heart reveals a warm blend of musc and cashmeran wood, giving the fragrance a soft, enveloping depth. The purse spray takes a quieter approach, with osmanthus providing a gentle floral note over a base of musc and amber wood, making it a natural companion to the main scent.
 Together they offer a layering experience that allows the wearer to adjust the weight and character of the fragrance throughout the day.

listings.rawTitle: Chloe Chloe 100ml Le Parfum Refillable
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=BPB3F9O]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Chloé Le Parfum takes the house's signature floral identity and adds warmth and depth, pairing orange blossom and rose with a tonka bean and vanilla accord that gives the dry down an ambery richness.
 The result is a fragrance that feels distinctly Chloé in its floral heart but leans warmer and more enveloping than the original, making it a natural step forward for the line.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense 30ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=VKNYLW1]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense Eau de Parfum is the heightened version of the house's Gardenia fragrance, offering a richer, woodier take on the floral at its core.
 The opening brings a bright lift of Italian Mandarin Essence before jasmine extract and tuberose take the composition into a deeper, creamier floral territory. Sandalwood Essence provides a warm, grounded base that lingers quietly on the skin and gives the fragrance its staying power.
 This 30ml eau de parfum is cruelty-free and vegan-friendly, making it a considered choice for those mindful of their beauty purchases.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense 50ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=IM6WAFA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense Eau de Parfum brings a fuller, richer dimension to the Flora Gorgeous Gardenia line, with a floral woody gourmand character that deepens as it develops on the skin.
 A clean citrus opening of Italian Mandarin Essence gives way to a heart of jasmine extract and tuberose, where the fragrance finds its warmth and body. Sandalwood Essence closes the composition with a grounded, woody softness that anchors the florals and extends the wear time throughout the day.
 The 100ml size offers strong value for a fragrance intended for regular use. Cruelty-free and vegan-friendly.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo 10ml + 4.5ml Eau de Parfum Gift Set
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=NPPG3BL]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Eau de Parfum is a gourmand-leaning floral fragrance that balances the freshness of citrus and peach with the depth of vanilla and benzoin.
 The opening combines mandarin juice with soft peach nuances for a bright, fruit-forward start. Red spider lily and jasmine sambac carry the heart with a warm, lush floral character that bridges the freshness of the top notes and the richness below. The base of vanilla and benzoin brings a deep, sweet warmth that lingers on the skin well after the initial spray.
 Presented as a 10ml and 4.5ml gift set in Jimmy Choo's peach-tinted bottle, finished with a hammered gold cap and JC monogram detail.

listings.rawTitle: Joop! Homme 125ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=GV7R3PD]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Launched in 2021, JOOP! Homme Eau de Parfum builds on the foundations of the original Homme fragrance, adding greater depth and intensity to the sweet, spiced composition the house established in 1989.
 Bergamot lifts the opening alongside cinnamon and hazelnut, offering a fresh contrast to the warmer notes beneath. The heart brings orange blossom and a powdery vanilla with a subtle honey quality, before tonka bean, sandalwood and moss round out the base into a smooth, lingering oriental dry down.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau So Intense 30ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=RYSUT3N]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Daisy Wild Eau So Intense is Marc Jacobs' more concentrated interpretation of Daisy Wild, built around the same floral and woody core but with a richer, more intense trail.
 The opening brings banana blossom alongside a developing heart of jasmine and tuberose, where the fragrance finds its fullest expression. Sandalwood and amber anchor the base with a warm, woody softness that gives the scent its staying power and ties the composition together.
 Presented in the Daisy Wild bottle reimagined in ombré and vivid tones, setting it apart from the original within the range.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Elixir 30ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=GHWIHSM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Marc Jacobs Perfect Elixir builds on the warmth of the original Perfect fragrance, deepening the composition with resinous base notes and a darker, more complex opening that gives it a distinct character within the range.
 A top accord of purple rhubarb, plum and honey nectar sets a rich, fruity tone before Egyptian orange blossom absolute and golden amber woods bring a warm, full-bodied floral quality to the heart. The base of vanilla bean extract, myrrh and patchouli gives the fragrance a smooth, lasting depth that carries through hours of wear.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Extreme 75g Deodorant Stick
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=KGYME20]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}The Montblanc Explorer Extreme Deodorant Stick extends the Explorer Extreme scent into the daily grooming routine, pairing reliable odour control with a fragrance that echoes the eau de parfum it accompanies.
 Bergamot opens the composition with a clean citrus brightness, while patchouli, vetiver and amber bring depth and warmth. The leather accord adds a dry, distinctive character that gives the overall scent a more complex feel than a standard deodorant.
 Formulated for smooth application, this stick is a practical companion to the Explorer Extreme fragrance line.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb 20ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=N782CM4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Flowerbomb by Viktor & Rolf is a floral oriental fragrance built around an intense bouquet of jasmine, rose and freesia, grounded by patchouli and vanilla for a warm, lasting dry down.
 The opening combines jasmine, freesia and orchid into a layered floral accord that feels full and assured from the first spray. Centifolia rose and Sambac jasmine carry the heart with a deep, sweet richness before patchouli and vanilla take hold in the base, bringing warmth and an earthy smoothness that gives the fragrance its staying power on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb 30ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=SEOWBV6]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum is a richly floral oriental fragrance with a fresh, tea-led opening that gives way to one of the most layered floral hearts in the category.
 Tea, bergamot and osmanthus open cleanly before jasmine, rose, freesia, orchid and African orange flower build the heart into a full, sweet and complex bouquet. The base of patchouli, musk and vanilla brings a warm, grounding finish that softens the florals and gives the fragrance its notable depth and longevity.
 At 30ml, this is a neat entry point into the Flowerbomb range, housed in the house's distinctive diamond grenade bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb 15ml Body Cream
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=M15KDIE]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}The Flowerbomb Body Cream from Viktor & Rolf brings the house's well-known floral oriental scent into a moisturising cream, conditioning the skin while leaving it wrapped in a soft, lasting fragrance.
 Jasmine, rose and freesia form the heart of the scent as it sits on the skin, with patchouli and vanilla giving the dry down a gentle warmth and sweetness. Used alongside the eau de parfum, the cream helps build and extend the Flowerbomb scent throughout the day.
 The 15ml size makes it a practical addition to a travel bag or a neat complement to the fragrance as a gift.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous 4 x 5ml Eau de Parfum Gift Set
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=MGRACUH]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Gucci Flora Gorgeous Miniature Gift Set offers four distinct floral eau de parfums in 5ml sizes, drawing from the Flora collection's range of characters from soft and sweet through to fresh and fruity.
 Gorgeous Gardenia brings a creamy, feminine sweetness, Gorgeous Magnolia a warm radiance, and Gorgeous Jasmine a lighter, more delicate quality. Gorgeous Orchid adds a fruity richness to the set, giving it a well-rounded spread across different floral moods and occasions.
 Neatly presented, the four miniatures make a considered gift or a practical way to sample the collection before committing to a full size.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous 3 x 10ml Eau de Parfum Gift Set
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=X7AP0Y1]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}The Gucci Flora Gorgeous Trio Pen Spray Gift Set offers three fragrances from the Flora collection in a portable pen spray format, spanning the soft creaminess of Gardenia, the deeper intensity of Gardenia Intense, and the fruitier warmth of Orchid.
 Each pen spray is compact enough for a bag or pocket, making the set a practical way to rotate between three complementary florals throughout the week. The range of characters across the three ensures there is something suited to different moods and settings.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau So Intense 100ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=TISGTVB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Daisy Wild Eau So Intense takes Marc Jacobs' floral and woody Daisy Wild composition and amplifies it, with a deeper, more concentrated character that carries further and lasts longer on the skin.
 The opening banana blossom accord gives the fragrance a light, fruity entry point before jasmine and tuberose develop into a rich, layered floral heart. Amber and sandalwood provide the base with a warm, woody depth that anchors the composition and gives it its staying power.
 The 100ml bottle comes in the Daisy Wild signature design, updated in ombré tones that set the Eau So Intense apart within the range.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild 30ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=N671C18]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau de Parfum is a fresh floral fragrance centred on jasmine, banana blossom and a warm woody base, presented here in a newly refillable 30ml format that marks a first for the Daisy line.
 The fragrance opens on a light banana blossom accord before jasmine and macadamia build a soft, rounded floral heart with a subtle creaminess. Sandalwood and vetiver des sables close the composition with a dry, earthy warmth that ties the freshness of the top notes to a more grounded finish.
 The bottle is reimagined in light green with signature Daisy flowers on the cap and flower stems running through the glass, and is compatible with the 150ml sustainable refill to reduce waste over time.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Intense 50ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=AA3AD19]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}For Her Eau de Parfum Intense takes Narciso Rodriguez's signature musc accord and builds a more intense, layered composition around it, created alongside perfumer Sonia Constant with fresh fruit, white florals and vanilla.
 A peach and bergamot opening gives the fragrance an immediately bright, juicy quality before solar white flowers amplify the musc at the heart of the composition. Vetiver brings an earthy, woody grounding to the base that adds complexity to the softer, creamier elements above.
 Presented in a deep pink flacon that distinguishes it from the original For Her bottle, this is a vegan fragrance with noticeably more depth and projection than its predecessor.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Divine 100ml Eau de Parfum Gift Set
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=CJ1BLF7]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Gaultier Divine Eau de Parfum brings a marine floral character to Jean Paul Gaultier's fragrance range, pairing a salty, citrus-led opening with a warm floral heart and a light, airy base.
 Pink berry, bergamot and calypsone give the opening a fresh, slightly saline quality that sets the fragrance apart from a more conventional floral. Jasmine, solar lily and ylang-ylang develop the heart with warmth and depth before meringue and musk bring a soft, powdery sweetness to the dry down that lingers gently on the skin.
 Presented in a refillable bottle shaped with the house's signature curves and finished with a gold corset detail.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia 100ml Eau de Parfum Set
listings.description: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia   Gift Set sits comfortably in the elegant category without trying too hard. This eau de parfum from Gucci keeps things floral and approachable.You'll catch Bergamot, Citrus straight away before Jasmine, Rose emerge in the heart. It finishes with Vanilla, Musk, which is where the fragrance really finds its character and sticks around.At 100ml, there's enough here to last through consistent wear without needing to restock every few weeks. The eau de parfum concentration means it projects well without being overwhelming in close quarters.Fragrance Notes:Top Notes: Bergamot, Citrus, Fresh floralsMiddle Notes: Jasmine, Rose, Floral bouquetBase Notes: Vanilla, Musk, Woody notes

listings.description: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia   Gift Set sits comfortably in the elegant category without trying too hard. This eau de parfum from Gucci keeps things floral and approachable.You'll catch Bergamot, Citrus straight away before Jasmine, Rose emerge in the heart.
