listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love 100ml Eau de Parfum Gift Set
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=FGIRJ22]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love Eau de Parfum is a layered floral built on zesty citrus, soft blooms and a warm, musky base. Bright, alluring and effortlessly wearable.
 Mandarin and orange flower petals lead the opening with a fresh, sparkling energy before giving way to a floral heart of hibiscus and freesia that adds femininity and depth. As the scent settles, vanilla and rich musks draw the composition into a smooth, seductive dry down that sits close to the skin.
 Equally comfortable worn during the day as it is on an evening out, this Eau de Parfum carries enough presence to feel special without ever being overpowering.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Million Gold For Her 90ml Eau de Parfum Gift Set
listings.description: Since its release, Paco Rabanne Million Gold For Her   Intense has become known for its elegant character. The 90ml bottle offers an elegant fragrance that combines fresh floral notes with a warm, sophisticated base.You'll catch Bergamot, Citrus straight away before Jasmine, Rose emerge in the heart. It finishes with Vanilla, Musk, which is where the fragrance really finds its character and sticks around.The 90ml size works well if this becomes part of your regular rotation. This eau de parfum has decent longevity, so you're not reapplying constantly throughout the day.Scent Profile:Opening - Bergamot, Citrus, Fresh floralsHeart - Jasmine, Rose, Floral bouquetDry Down - Vanilla, Musk, Woody notes

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'interdit Intense 35ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description:
L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Intense by Givenchy is a bold floral amber fragrance for women who love a scent with depth and character. A richer take on the original L'Interdit, this version turns up the warmth and sensuality.
 
 It opens with a spark of black pepper before settling into a heart of creamy tuberose and soft orange blossom. The base brings everything together with Madagascan vanilla, sesame, patchouli, and vetiver, leaving a smooth amber trail that lingers beautifully on the skin.
 
 Launched by Givenchy in 2020, L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Intense is housed in the brand's signature black and white bottle and makes an ideal choice for evenings, date nights, or special occasions.
 
 Fragrance Family: Floral Amber
 
 Top Notes: Black Pepper
 Heart Notes: Tuberose, Orange Blossom
 Base Notes: Sesame, Madagascan Vanilla, Patchouli, Vetiver

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Buongiorno 200g Candle
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=EFRWQBB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Buongiorno brings Italian countryside mornings into your space. The scent opens with fresh cut grass, the kind that smells green and bright like an early morning mow. Clean linen adds that sun dried outdoor freshness, while wood notes and soft moss give it warmth and depth. It's fresh without being sharp, cosy without getting too sweet or heavy.
 Yellow glass jar with Art Deco styling. Recyclable FSC packaging.
 Safety: Keep wax clean of matches and debris. Stop using at 5mm wax level. Never leave burning unattended. Keep away from curtains and flammable materials. Let cool completely before moving.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bloom 100ml Eau de Parfum Set
listings.description: Gucci's take on a elegant fragrance delivers here. Gucci Bloom   Gift Set blends floral notes with feminine undertones in this 100ml eau de parfum.The opening burst of Bergamot, Citrus gives way to Jasmine, Rose fairly quickly. What lingers is the base combination of Vanilla, Musk, which is really where this fragrance lives most of the day.The 100ml size works well if this becomes part of your regular rotation. This eau de parfum has decent longevity, so you're not reapplying constantly throughout the day.Fragrance Notes:Top Notes: Bergamot, Citrus, Fresh floralsMiddle Notes: Jasmine, Rose, Floral bouquetBase Notes: Vanilla, Musk, Woody notes

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau So Extra Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=GDBQ8OE]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Launched in 2026, Daisy Wild Eau So Extra is Marc Jacobs' most gourmand entry in the Daisy Wild range, built around a combination of creamy fruit, chocolate florals and a warm, lingering base.
 The opening brings blue banana and pear nectar alongside bergamot and the unusual Chocolate Daisy Scentrek, a note that weaves a soft cocoa quality through the freshness of the fruit. Jasmine Sambac and orange flower anchor the floral heart while a Chocolate Viennois accord adds a further layer of richness before vanilla, sandalwood and a trio of vetiver bring the fragrance to a smooth, grounded close.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Eau de Parfum 50ml + 75ml Gift Set
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=XWWAUO1]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Burberry Hero Eau de Parfum draws on the character of a forest growing by the English coast, combining resinous incense and benzoin with a cedarwood and pine base for a woody fragrance with a cool, natural quality.
 The incense and benzoin sit at the centre of the composition, bringing a warm smokiness that is tempered by the freshness of cedarwood oils and pine below. The overall effect is clean and outdoors-inspired, with the kind of depth that carries well through the day without feeling heavy.
 Presented as a gift set alongside the matching Burberry Hero deodorant, in the angular see-through glass bottle with the Burberry logo and black cap.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Bold Elixir Intense Parfum 100ml
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=KG41NQ4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Calvin Klein Euphoria Bold Elixir Parfum Intense takes the Euphoria lineage into richer, more intense territory, pairing a vibrant fruit opening with a deep floral heart and a warm, woody base.
 Pomegranate and persimmon give the fragrance a bright, slightly tart opening before orchid and lotus build a warm, opulent floral core. The base of amber, mahogany wood, gourmand cream and musk brings a smooth, skin-like warmth to the dry down that gives the parfum intense its lasting character and presence.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Solar Elixir Intense Parfum 100ml
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=HTH9TVD]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Euphoria Solar Elixir Eau de Parfum by Calvin Klein takes its cue from vanilla in its green stage, building a bright, sunlit scent around blooming florals and a warm, indulgent base. Golden, sweet and radiant.
 Juicy mango lifts the opening before a golden orchid heart brings a soft, sensual depth. Creamy vanilla then settles into the base, rich and comforting, leaving a sweet trail that holds close to the skin.
 A high concentration gives the fragrance its lasting intensity, making it a natural fit for summer days and balmy evenings alike. Feminine and easy to wear, with staying power that carries through the day.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Emporia Armani Power of You Eau de Parfum 90ml
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=XER3GSQ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Power of You Eau de Parfum by Emporio Armani is a warm, gourmand fragrance designed to bring out a sense of feminine confidence. Sweet, creamy and bold.
 A sweet-tart burst of maracuja passion fruit opens the scent with juicy vibrancy, giving way to a dessert-rich frangipani centre layered in sugary, creamy florals. Vanilla absolute anchors the base, melting into the sweetness above so the whole composition stays soft and rounded.
 Housed in a blush-pink flacon with a rose gold-edged finish and matching cap, it makes for a pretty addition to any dressing table. Wearable across the day and into the evening for anyone drawn to sweeter scents.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Society Ambree Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=NDND5MJ]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Ambrée by Givenchy is a spicy, amber-rich evolution of the Gentleman Society line, made for a bold and assured wearer. Warm, masculine and grounded.
 Clary sage and nutmeg set an aromatic opening before vetiver and narcissus bring the boldness the Gentleman series is known for. An amber fusion then takes a spicier turn in the base, moving through balsam, tobacco and tasuki vanilla for a warm, lasting finish.
 Lacquered entirely in black and finished with a champagne golden crest, the flacon carries the look of the house of Givenchy. A natural fit for evenings and colder months, with the kind of depth that holds through the day.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L’Interdit Parfum 80ml
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=SVHPMVM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}L'Interdit Parfum from Givenchy brings a richer, more intense dimension to the house's signature white floral fragrance, with an unusual almond opening that sets it apart from more conventional florals.
 Sweet almond leads the opening before orange blossom, tuberose and jasmine unfold into a warm, full-bodied floral heart. The base of vetiver, patchouli and benzoin brings a darker, earthier quality that deepens the composition considerably and gives it a lasting, multi-layered dry down.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Intensement Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=HTFFJH1]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}La Vie Est Belle Intensément Eau de Parfum by Lancôme is a richer expression of the much-loved La Vie Est Belle, a fruity floral built for women who like their scent warm and full. Floral, sweet and deep.
 Bergamot, pink pepper and raspberry give a bright, fruity opening before jasmine sambac and orange blossom unfold at the heart. Patchouli and iris bring an earthy depth to the base, rounded out by the sensual sweetness of benzoin and vanilla for a warm, lasting finish.
 The fragrance shows through the smiling bottle in a fuchsia shade, with a bow tied at the neck in a fiery colour. Suited to cooler evenings and everyday wear alike for anyone who enjoys a deeper floral.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Donna Born in Roma Coral Fantasy Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=B6N0UUO]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Valentino Donna Born In Roma Coral Fantasy is a floral fruity eau de parfum inspired by Rome at golden hour, opening with a bright, fruit-led energy before settling into a warmer, more refined finish.
 Strawberry and bergamot give the opening a vibrant, juicy quality before Jasmine Grandiflorum takes over the heart with a clean, feminine floral character. Cedar and vetiver close the fragrance with a soft woody warmth that adds depth to the composition and gives it a lasting trail on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Eau de Toilette 200ml Gift Set
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=RT34QAA]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male is an aromatic fragrance for men that has remained a consistent presence in the category since its 1995 launch, built around a fresh, spiced composition with a warm, creamy base.
 Mint, lavender, bergamot and artemisia open the fragrance with a clean, aromatic freshness before caraway, cinnamon and orange blossom introduce a warmer, spiced quality at the heart. Vanilla, sandalwood, tonka bean and amber close the composition with a smooth, comforting depth that gives Le Male its lasting and distinctive character on the skin.
 This set includes a 200ml eau de toilette and a 10ml eau de toilette, presented in the house's well-known torso-shaped bottle and signature tin packaging.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle Rosea Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=OB8HHEB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle Rosea is a floral aquatic eau de parfum launched in 2026, built around a celebration of feminine strength and individuality with a fresh, skin-close character.
 Crisp aquatic notes open with an airy freshness before a peony accord develops at the heart with a soft, radiant quality. Warm vanilla draws the fragrance to a close, adding a gentle sweetness that settles on the skin and carries a smooth, lasting trail through the day.
 Conceived as a composition that moves with the wearer, La Belle Rosea is designed to feel personal rather than overpowering, making it a natural fit as an everyday signature.

listings.rawTitle: Lanvin Éclat d'Arpège Eau de Parfum 100ml Gift Set
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=WB1W5KL]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Lanvin Éclat d'Arpège is a fresh floral eau de parfum built around a soft, feminine bouquet of peony, wisteria and osmanthus, balanced by a clean, fruity quality and a warm woody base.
 Lemon and lilac open the fragrance with a light, green freshness before peach, tea and a layered floral heart of osmanthus, peony and wisteria bring a delicate, rounded softness to the composition. Amber, cedar and musk close the fragrance with a gentle warmth that gives it a subtle depth and a clean, lasting trail on the skin.
 This gift set contains a 100ml eau de parfum, a 7.5ml miniature and a 100ml body lotion, allowing the scent to be layered through the daily routine and extended throughout the day.

listings.rawTitle: DKNY BE Delicious 100ml + 30ml Eau de Parfum Gift Set
listings.description: DKNY BE Delicious   + 30ml Set sits comfortably in the elegant category without trying too hard. This eau de parfum from DKNY keeps things floral and approachable.Opening with Bergamot, Citrus, the first impression is elegant and immediate. The heart brings in Jasmine, Rose, adding layers that develop nicely over time. By the dry down, you're left with Vanilla, Musk carrying the fragrance forward with good staying power.Whether you're wearing this to work or out for dinner, it adapts fairly well. The 100ml size means you're covered for a while, and the eau de parfum format delivers enough presence without filling a room.Scent Profile:Opening - Bergamot, Citrus, Fresh floralsHeart - Jasmine, Rose, Floral bouquetDry Down - Vanilla, Musk, Woody notes

listings.rawTitle: Tom Ford Black Orchid Reserve 50ml Parfum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=YCFIPL4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Tom Ford Black Orchid Reserve Parfum Spray 50ml takes the original Black Orchid somewhere darker and more intense.
 At its heart is the familiar Black Orchid accord, now paired with a bigger dose of ylang ylang and a mysterious Ghost Orchid note that gives the fragrance a new dimension. Timut pepper adds a lively, spicy sparkle, while black truffle grounds it with something rich and earthy.
 As it settles, roasted tonka, patchouli and amber come through, leaving a warm, deep trail that stays with you long after you've sprayed it.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Green Man 75ml Deodorant Stick
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=LFYLA77]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Hugo Man Deodorant Stick extends the Hugo Man fragrance experience into a daily grooming essential, combining reliable odour protection with the scent character of the eau de toilette it accompanies.
 Green apple gives the opening a crisp, fresh quality, while aromatic herbs add a clean, energetic lift. Fir balsam anchors the base with a cool, woody depth that gives the stick a distinctly outdoors character and a fresh, lasting scent throughout the day.
 A practical complement to the Hugo Man fragrance line, designed to be worn alongside the eau de toilette for a layered, cohesive scent.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Boss The Scent 75ml Deodorant Stick
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=DC6F9H9]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Hugo Boss The Scent Deodorant Stick brings the aromatic spicy character of the Boss The Scent fragrance into a daily grooming format, pairing effective odour control with a scent that complements the eau de toilette it accompanies.
 Ginger and bergamot open with a fresh, spiced quality before exotic maninka adds a warm, distinctive character at the heart. Leather anchors the base with a dry, smooth depth that gives the stick a lingering, masculine presence on the skin throughout the day.
 Used alongside Boss The Scent Eau de Toilette, the stick helps to layer and extend the fragrance's overall presence.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Invictus Deodorant Stick 75g
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=QF0DXFH]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}The Rabanne Invictus Deodorant Stick carries the woody aquatic character of the Invictus Eau de Toilette into a daily grooming format, offering reliable odour protection alongside the scent it accompanies.
 Grapefruit and a fresh marine accord open with a crisp, energetic quality before guaiac wood and patchouli bring a warmer, more sensual depth. Ambergris anchors the base with a smooth, skin-close warmth that gives the stick a lasting trail without overpowering the fragrance worn alongside it.
 Used with the Invictus Eau de Toilette, the stick helps to build and extend the overall scent through the day.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne 1 Million 75ml Deodorant Stick
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=HSB9B48]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}The Rabanne 1 Million Deodorant Stick brings the woody spicy character of the 1 Million Eau de Toilette into a daily grooming format, combining effective underarm protection with a scent that complements the fragrance it accompanies.
 Grapefruit, blood mandarin and mint give the opening a fresh, fruity brightness before rose, cinnamon and spice build a warmer, more assertive heart. Leather, amber and Indonesian patchouli anchor the base with a smooth, rich depth that gives the stick a bold, lasting trail on the skin throughout the day.
 A natural complement to the 1 Million Eau de Toilette, helping to layer and extend the fragrance's overall presence.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Phantom Parfum 100ml 3pc Set
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=CSCTC2I]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Rabanne Phantom Parfum is the deeper, more intense concentration of the Phantom line, centred on a bold combination of lavender, vanilla and vetiver that gives it a darker, more assertive character than the original eau de toilette.
 Electrifying lavender opens the fragrance with a clean, aromatic lift before vanilla brings a warm, rich sweetness to the heart. Vetiver anchors the base with an earthy, smoky depth that gives the parfum concentration its weight and lasting presence on the skin.
 This gift set contains the 100ml parfum, a 150ml deodorant and a 10ml travel spray, presented in Phantom's distinctive matte black bottle that marks a step up from the chromatic silver of the original.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'interdit Eau de Toilette 80ml
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=CFE5HIN]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Toilette is a 2022 reinvention of the house's white floral signature, lightening the ambery tones of its predecessor to let the florals and earthy base notes take centre stage.
 Orange, bergamot and mandarin open with a bright, fruity sweetness before a dense white floral heart of orange blossom, neroli, tuberose and jasmine grandiflorum and sambac develops a luminous, slightly creamy quality on the skin. Patchouli, vetiver and sandalwood bring an earthy warmth to the base that gives the fragrance an unexpected depth, softened by musk and cistus flower that keep the floral character alive through the dry down.
 The juice is housed in Givenchy's sleek glass bottle, partially made from recycled glass.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Deodorant Stick 75g
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=TL5XJ90]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Deodorant Stick carries the aromatic character of the house's 1995 fragrance into a daily grooming format, combining effective underarm protection with the scent that made Le Male a lasting presence in masculine perfumery.
 Cardamom, bergamot, mint and lavender open with a clean, fresh quality that evokes the familiar sharpness of shaving soap, before cinnamon, orange blossom and caraway add a warmer, spiced complexity at the heart. Cedar, vanilla, tonka bean and sandalwood anchor the base with a smooth, creamy warmth that gives the stick a lasting, skin-close trail throughout the day.
 A natural complement to the Le Male eau de toilette, extending the fragrance's presence as part of a wider grooming routine.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Narcisse Eau de Parfum 7ml
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=AQPI7F2]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Narcisse is a fresh aromatic eau de parfum with a warm, musky core that gives it a confident, sensual character distinct from the original Le Beau.
 Bergamot opens with a bright, sparkling citrus quality before the fragrance settles into a smooth musky heart with a subtle amber warmth. Tonka bean deepens the base, adding a rich, creamy depth that gives Le Beau Narcisse its lasting, skin-close signature.
 Available here in a 7ml spray, a practical size for travel or as an introduction to the fragrance before committing to a full bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Ralph's Club 100ml Parfum
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=W317NU0]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Step inside Ralph's Club, the after-hours spot where style and music collide.
 Ralph's Club Parfum is the strongest version yet. A concentrated masculine scent built for men who dress on their own terms and stay out late.
 Every ingredient has been picked for quality, which is why the trail sticks around long after you've left the room.
 The scent opens fresh with lavandin, then takes a turn with warm, spicy cardamom. Deep vetiver gives it real intensity, softened by rich patchouli underneath.
 Bold, woody and sensual. A fragrance made for nights spent in good company.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Pour Elle Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=VAY10AF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Azzaro Pour Elle is a floral gourmand eau de parfum inspired by the warmth of Mediterranean mornings, built around a rose heart with a bright citrus opening and a soft, woody base.
 Lemon essence opens with a clean, sun-drenched freshness before a sensual rose note develops at the heart, carrying a soft, slightly sweet quality that gives the fragrance its feminine character. Sandalwood essence closes the composition with a gentle warmth that grounds the florals and gives the dry down a smooth, skin-close finish that lingers through the day.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Splendida Magnolia Sensuel Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=TKTLMUG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Bvlgari Splendida Magnolia Sensuel is a floral eau de parfum crafted by Jacques Cavallier, placing the magnolia at the heart of a composition that balances fresh citrus brightness with a rich, creamy warmth.
 Mandarin essence opens with a clean, sunny quality before a sparkling magnolia heart develops a soft, luminous floral character. Vanilla absolute from Tahiti closes the fragrance with a rich, creamy depth that gives the dry down a warm, sensual quality that carries well on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Society Extreme Eau de Parfum 200ml
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=KJWCFRV]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Extrême is a deeper, more intense concentration within the Gentleman Society line, built around exceptional raw materials and a composition that moves between aromatic freshness and rich, woody warmth.
 Clary sage, peppermint and nutmeg open with an immediate aromatic and spiced quality before the heart reveals narcissus absolute and iris concrete alongside a signature vetiver quartet. A coffee extract absolute develops unexpectedly within the heart, paired with peppermint essence for an iced, textured quality that gives the fragrance a distinctive and complex mid-stage. Cedarwood, sandalwood, patchouli and vanilla absolute close the composition with a deep, woody warmth that gives the dry down considerable presence and longevity.
 The bottle takes the Gentleman silhouette in a new direction with a deep black lacquer finish and the 4G logo in gunmetal, made from 15% post-consumer recycled glass.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Hugo Woman Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=DW3T3M4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Hugo Boss Hugo Woman Eau de Parfum is a fruity floral fragrance launched in 2015, opening on a fresh, green accord before moving into a richer, more complex heart of tea, jasmine and plum.
 Blackberry, dew-soaked grass and Italian mandarin give the opening a fresh, slightly tart quality before iris, black tea, plum and jasmine develop a warm, layered floral heart with a soft, earthy depth. Amber, cedarwood and sandalwood close the composition with a smooth woody warmth that gives the fragrance a grounded, lasting dry down.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Intense Eau de Toilette 75ml
Montblanc Legend Red Eau de Parfum 200ml
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=F36LQFW]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Montblanc Legend Red Eau de Parfum is a woody, fruity fragrance for men, designed to embolden and empower the wearer. It opens with the citrus energy of blood orange and grapefruit, lifted by a touch of cardamom, before leading into an intense, aromatic heart of clary sage, juniper and cedar.
 The scent culminates in a woody dry down of mahogany, tonka bean and Atlas cedar, giving it warmth and lasting depth.

listings.rawTitle: Paco Rabanne Phantom Parfum 100ml Gift Set
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=L9OUM80]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Paco Rabanne Phantom Parfum is a bold, modern woody fragrance for men, launched by the Spanish house in 2023. It opens with a lively burst of cardamom, rhubarb, bergamot and lemon, giving it a bright, energetic start.
 The heart brings together lavender, patchouli, geranium and cedarwood for a smooth, aromatic core with a rich masculine edge. The base then settles into vanilla, tolu balsam and Haitian vetiver, leaving a warm, sensual trail that lasts.
 This set includes a 100ml Parfum and a 20ml travel spray, making it just as perfect for gifting as it is for treating yourself.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Angel Fantasm Eau de Parfum 50ml
Viktor & Rolf Good Fortune Elixir Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=XOPO37U]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Viktor & Rolf Good Fortune Elixir Intense Eau de Parfum is a luxurious, mysterious floral fragrance for women, a more intense interpretation of the original Good Fortune. It opens with an enchanting incense note, addictive and sensual from the start.
 At the heart, a jasmine superinfusion takes centre stage, blooming with velvety, solar warmth. The base then unveils a mystical palo santo accord intertwined with rich Bourbon vanilla and precious Caledonian sandalwood, all within a vegan composition.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Gaultier Divine Le Parfum Intense 100ml Gift Set
listings.description:
#html-body [data-pb-style=SQFCA6I]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}The Jean Paul Gaultier Divine Le Parfum Gift Set brings together a radiant amber floral fragrance for women, launched by the French house in 2024. Divine Le Parfum blends soft floral tones with warm, glowing accents, opening with bright solar notes and the delicate touch of lily for a fresh, uplifting start.
 At the heart, frangipani and a hint of sea salt create a breezy, exotic character that feels both graceful and bold. The base then finishes with warm amber and rich benzoin, leaving a lasting impression of depth and elegance.
 Designed in France and drawing on the bold creativity of the Jean Paul Gaultier house, the fragrance brings a touch of Parisian glamour to a daily routine. The set includes a 100ml Eau de Parfum, a 75ml body lotion and a 10ml mini spray, making it just as good for gifting as it is for treating yourself.

An elegant fragrance that combines fresh floral notes with a warm, sophisticated base, wrapped up in a 30ml bottle.The composition starts with Bergamot, Citrus up front, then settles into Jasmine, Rose as it warms on skin. The base of Vanilla, Musk anchors everything and gives it longevity worth noting.The 30ml size works well if this becomes part of your regular rotation. listings.description:

Festive, feminine and beautifully presented.
 La Petite Robe Noire is a floral fruity fragrance built on rose, black cherry, black tea and patchouli, capturing a playful Parisian elegance with a darker, more textured edge. The travel-sized flacon mirrors the full-sized scent in a compact, bag-friendly format for wearing on the go.
 The gift box is reusable with a removable inner tray, made from FSC-certified recyclable materials. A polished seasonal set that feels considered and ready to give as it is.

listings.rawTitle: Armaf Hunter 100ml Eau de Toilette
listings.description: Armaf Hunter is a fresh aromatic fougere. This 100ml eau de toilette combines citrus brightness with lavender and woods, creating a clean and sophisticated composition.The fragrance opens with vibrant bergamot, lemon and herbs that create immediate freshness. The heart reveals lavender, spices and florals that add aromatic depth. This classic blend balances brightness with masculine warmth.The base features smooth woods, amber and musk that provide lasting elegance. The result is a versatile scent perfect for professional settings.Top notes: Bergamot, Lemon, HerbsMiddle notes: Lavender, Spices, FloralsBase notes: Woods, Amber, Musk
